title: Meridian on-prem weekly sync prep (scratch)
body:
Purpose / meeting intent:
- Prep notes for Wednesday 10:00am (Meridian customer weekly) 
- Quick status check + unblock list for the next sprints: VPC peering, KMS, image rollout, GPU node readiness, smoke testing.
- Goal: have clear owners and dates for remaining infra work so solutions-eng can sign off on final checklist by Thu EOD.

Attendees (target):
- Meridian: Priya Shah (Infra lead), Mateo Cruz (Security), Li Wei (Platform)
- Redwood: Ava Dobson (SE owner), Ravi Patel (SRE), Marta Nguyen (Infra Eng), Jordan Lee (Customer Success)

Context / current snapshot (fast bullets):
- Customer cluster provisioned in us-west-2 on their account via terraform (branch: meridian/provision-v3).
- Control-plane access: ok (jumpbox + bastion). Connectivity tests passed internally but Meridian reported intermittent NAT egress failures during large image pulls on 02/28.
- GPUs: 6x A100S 80GB provisioned, but kubelet on 2 nodes reporting UDEV errors (NVMe mapping) → nodes in NotReady intermittently.
- KMS: customer wants external KMS (CloudHSM) integration; we have KMS handshake PoC but key wrapping flow failing during initial test (IAM role missing kms:Decrypt).
- Private registry: they use internal Harbor behind ALB; image pull credentials TTL expiry not handled by our deployment script (image pull secret rotation needed).

Draft agenda (15m):
1) Quick wins (2m) - what finished last week (node reprovision, LB rule applied)
2) Blockers (6m) - each blocker, short root cause, ask of customer or infra owner
3) Plan / owners (5m) - who does what by when
4) Risks + follow-ups (2m)

Known blockers (to raise explicitly)
- Node UDEV/NVMe errors (owner: Marta) 
  - Symptoms: dmesg shows repeated nvme namespace rename errors; kubelet marks node NotReady during heavy IO (image pulls > 5GB). Suspected kernel + NVMe driver mismatch on their custom AMIs.
  - Next step: get exact AMI kernel version (ask Meridian to run: uname -a ; sudo dmesg | grep -i nvme > nvme.log).
  - Mitigation: reprovision nodes on standard AWS Deep Learning AMI or upgrade kernel. Tentative ETA if customer agrees to re-provision: 48-72h.

- KMS key access (owner: Ravi / Meridian IAM)
  - Symptoms: handshake fails with AccessDenied when Redwood runtime attempts to unwrap model encryption key via customer's CloudHSM-backed KMS key (fails on kms:Decrypt).
  - Immediate ask for Meridian: add Redwood role (arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ROLE_ID) to key policy with kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey permissions.
  - Work item: Ravi to produce minimal policy snippet + test script by Tue EOD. (Linked: PD-1423)

- Registry image pull secret rotation (owner: Jordan)
  - Symptoms: after 12h, pods fail to pull updated images because Harbor issues ephemeral tokens. Our deployment pipeline does not re-create imagePullSecrets dynamically.
  - Short-term workaround: create long-lived robot account in Harbor scoped to the deployment namespace (customer ok?) -> discuss during sync.
  - Long-term: integrate credential fetcher sidecar or adapt deploy pipeline to refresh secrets (RFC -> infra backlog INF-887).

- Network egress / NAT burst failures (owner: Li Wei (customer) + Ava)
  - Observed when >10 nodes pull simultaneously; some pulls stall then timeout. Could be NAT gateway scaling or ephemeral ENI limits.
  - Ask: Li Wei to share VPC flow logs for a 1-hour window (from last incident) and current NAT gateway CloudWatch metrics.
  - Action: Ava to run a quick smoke with staggered pulls next Tue to reproduce and measure thresholds; if confirmed, propose S3 multipart caching + prefetch step in onboarding script.

Prep checklist (things to mention / confirm in meeting)
- [ ] Customer will run uname -a and paste kernel + AMI id in thread (NVMe debug)
- [ ] Meridian to attach CloudHSM KMS key policy snippet or willingness to add Redwood role
- [ ] Decide short-term registry credential strategy (robot account vs token refresher)
- [ ] Confirm which 2 nodes to reprovision for NVMe test (target low-traffic ones)
- [ ] Agree on schedule for final smoke test (target Thu morning)

Action items (explicit owners and tentative due dates)
- Marta: compile node kernel and nvme logs from control-plane node, and share recommended reprovision AMI by Thu 2026-03-12. (ownered)
- Meridian / Priya: run uname -a and upload nvme.log to shared Confluence page by Wed 2026-03-11.
- Ravi: draft minimal KMS key policy + test harness (small Python script that attempts kms:Decrypt) and post to thread by Tue 2026-03-10.
- Jordan: validate acceptability of creating Harbor robot account and send scope/TTL proposal to customer by Wed 2026-03-11.
- Ava: run staggered-image-pull smoke test in staging with 30-second offsets next Tue 2026-03-10 and capture metrics (latency, error rate); share results in next sync.

Risks / escalation notes (to mention quickly)
- If NVMe kernel issue persists and customer cannot re-provision quickly, schedule slip of 1 sprint (2 weeks) for model rollout; prepare rollback of partial capacity to hosted fallback.
- KMS access delays block encrypted model loading; contingency: agree to temporary use of an unencrypted test model for smoke tests (customer approval required).

Questions / open items (for Meridian)
- Are we permitted to create a scoped robot account in Harbor, or is there internal policy forbidding long-lived credentials?
- Is there a maintenance window the week of Mar 15 we should avoid? Any sprint freeze?
- Who is Meridian SRE primary after-hours contact for reprovision window?

Notes-to-self (fragments / quick references)
- Bring up PD-1423 at 1st follow-up if no KMS action in 48h.
- Check GH PR 401 for registry-refresh helper script — maybe merge will help but still needs infra review.
- Remember to push a short checklist into Confluence page: "Meridian Onprem Runbook -> Preflight checklist v1" after meeting.

Follow-ups after meeting (if items assigned)
- Schedule 30-min working session with Marta + Priya to reprovision two nodes and validate NVMe fix (calendar invite: "Meridian NVMe reprovision w/Redwood").
- If robot account ok, Jordan to coordinate creating credentials and update deployment script in PR (owner Jordan + INF eng reviewer).

Slack / communication plan
- Use #cust-meridian-private for async logs & file drops. Ask customer to post kernel logs there.
- For KMS policy exchange, use secure Confluence attachment + ephemeral email for private key ARNs.

Quick snippets / commands to ask Meridian to run (copy-paste):
- uname: uname -a
- nvme dmesg: sudo dmesg | grep -i nvme | tail -n 200 > nvme.log && gzip nvme.log
- pod events (if they can): kubectl -n redwood get events --field-selector type=Warning --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 200
- NAT check: aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace AWS/NATGateway --metric-name ActiveFlowCount --start-time 2026-02-28T08:00:00Z --end-time 2026-02-28T09:00:00Z --period 300 --statistics Maximum --region us-west-2

Draft meeting opener (two lines):
"Quick status check — we have three actionable infra items (NVMe nodes, KMS, registry secrets). For each we'll confirm owner and an ETA so we can lock the final smoke for Thu. Any blockers we don't own, call them out and we'll decide next steps"

End-of-doc notes / meta:
- This is intentionally a scratchpad — keep it short in meeting, move finalized tasks to Jira (PD-1423 child tasks) after sync.
- If anything shifts during meeting, update this doc then copy to Confluence stable page.

-- Ava
